sprout: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: transparent mobile game profile avatar for Lane, a teen driving-learning app. Redesign the referenced Sprout mascot as an original premium collectible soft matte vinyl figurine bust: a warm ivory round face inside an OLIVE GREEN frog-eared hood with two small sprout leaves, ochre workwear driving jacket, dark brown simple embroidered facial features, confident friendly asymmetrical smile, one hand giving a casual small wave. Preserve frog/sprout identity but replace neon green, candy pink, giant glossy baby eyes and shiny plastic with restrained olive #89936B, cream #F0E4CE, near-black brown #29251F, ochre #D19735. Small terracotta cheek marks only. A tiny simple road-stripe patch on chest, no text. Charming, expressive, playful and desirable for teenagers, bold readable silhouette at 40px, tangible rounded forms, subtle clay texture, crisp edges, limited material shading, no photorealism. Front-facing 3/4 slight turn, entire head and bust within square frame with 8 percent transparent margin, filling about 84 percent width and height. True transparent background, no floor, no shadow outside silhouette, no background circle, no UI, no lettering or watermark. One character only.
